The prior record's 12 regnorm STRUCTURAL rows are almost all ARTEFACT: eleven are branch-target words that differ by exactly 4 because we are one instruction short (blt <fn+0x118> vs <fn+0x114>, b <fn+0x1a4> vs <fn+0x1a0>, and so on). Closing the single `mr` closes them all; they are not eleven separate problems.

MECHANISM, RE-DERIVED FROM THE ALIGNED VIEW AND NOW EXACT. Both arms of this function inline TextLineHeight, whose value is `(n+1)*(fh+spacing)`, and in BOTH streams the accumulator `total` is coloured r3. ELSE ARM (identical on both sides): `addi r0,r6,1; mullw r0,r0,r8; add r3,r3,r0` - the product is built in r0 and added into total. IDX ARM, target: `addi r3,r5,1; add r0,r6,r30; mullw r0,r3,r0; mr r3,r0; b ->1a4`. IDX ARM, ours: `addi r3,r5,1; add r0,r6,r30; mullw r3,r3,r0; b ->1a0`. The two streams choose DIFFERENT DESTINATION REGISTERS FOR THE SAME MULTIPLY: the encoded operand pair is identical (rA=r3 = n+1, rB=r0 = fh+spacing) and only rD differs - retail overwrites rB (r0) and must then copy into total's home r3, while we overwrite rA (r3), which IS total's home, and need no copy. So the residual is a multiply DESTINATION-SELECTION choice that decides whether a copy is owed, i.e. copy coalescing decided one instruction earlier than usual.

TWO DISTINCT AXES MEASURED, BOTH FAILED, EACH WITH THE FAILURE READ. (1) SINGLE-EXIT ASSIGNMENT - rewrote the idx arm as `total = TextLineHeight(...)` inside an if/else with one trailing `return total;`. This is EXACTLY the shape the target's register assignment implies (total is r3 in both arms; the idx arm's `mr r3,r0` is a plain assignment into total's home; the `b ->1a4` jumps over the else arm to the shared epilogue). Result NEUTRAL - real 55, insns still 110, the same `mr` still missing: MWCC folded the assignment and targeted r3 directly, i.e. it COALESCED the copy retail declined to coalesce. The source shape is right and the allocator still differs. (2) HELPER RETURN-TEMP - gave the inlinee a named result local (`h = (n+1)*(fh+spacing); return h;`) to try to pin the product to its own web. REGRESSED real 55 -> 79 and did NOT create the mr, so the copy is not reachable from inside the inlinee either; the extra web merely perturbed colouring downstream.

DISPOSITION. The source shape is CONFIRMED CORRECT by axis (1) - do not re-derive it. What remains is a pure destination-register/coalescing decision on an anonymous r0 temp, count-asymmetric and therefore WebFrank-barred, with no named local able to serve as a carrier because the source register is r0. This is the same signature the ADDR16_LO census (claim.law.addr16-lo-home-copy-census-no-source-discriminant.20260831.v1) certified as allocator-worklist-internal and source-unreachable, in the mirror direction (we coalesce where retail does not). The one axis a future pass could still justify is an image-wide census of `mullw`/arithmetic destination-vs-operand selection paired with an owed `mr`, on the census method that settled the ADDR16_LO class - if that population is large it is a class worth one measurement, and if it is small this function should be accepted as a named one-instruction residual.
